subject: VP/CTO intro to unblock pilot and schedule prioritized demo

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@orchidanalytics.com>, Priya Raman <priya.r@orchidanalytics.com>

Subject: Quick recap + ask: VP/CTO intro and prioritized demo window

Hi Daniel / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Short recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum toward a pilot: 

- Key takeaways: Orchid needs predictable tail latency for 99th percentile production queries, token-cost transparency per pipeline, and stronger controls for data residency.
- Success metric for pilot: under 200ms p99 for 95% of queries at 2k qps with redwood batching + cache.
- Immediate blockers: exec alignment (VP/CTO signoff) and a technical deep-dive with your infra team to validate KV cache integration.

Proposed next steps (pick what works for you):
1) Short VP/CTO intro (15–20m) — helps unblock procurement/architecture signoff.
2) 60m technical deep-dive + demo (engineers + security) to validate integration approach.

Availability from our side: May 10 (10–12 PT) or May 12 (09–11 PT). We can do the VP/CTO intro on the same day as the deep-dive (first 20m warm handoff) or as a separate micro-call.

Attached: redwood-pilot-plan.pdf (one-pager with milestones). Mutual action plan link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xMutualActionPlan

If you can confirm who needs to be on the VP/CTO intro (name + role) and which of those two date windows works, I’ll lock time and share a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
